title: MZ Use icons for gauges or something like that

posts.author: ap9lsyn
posts.body:
Hello! Is there a plugin or any other way to change typical rpg maker hp/mp/tp gauges to something that would look like OMORI's beta battle ui?
Spoiler
My character in the game only has 5 MP for the entire game, so using a gauge to show MP isn't really effective. It would be better to use points or icons instead. I attempted to use "show image" commands for this, but it doesn't really work with the in-game ui like i wanted to. HUD Maker Ultra doesn't function well on Android devices or the web, so I need to find another way to implement it. Does anyone have any suggestions? Thanks in advance for your help!

posts.author: Slaughty
posts.body:
Moghunter had something like that for mv I believe they ported most of their battlehuds over to mz. They're all picture based so should be possible.
